paraphrase: Millions died of desire, millions of greed, millions for gold, woman and land; O Guhēśvara, I see none who died for you.
speaker: Allama Prabhu
notes: Skeleton from memory; locator is the incipit (or a descriptive key when the incipit is not recalled) because vacana numbering differs between editions — fix against the Samagra Vacana Sāhitya in Phase D.

paraphrase: They say gold is māyā — gold is not māyā; they say woman is māyā — woman is not māyā; they say land is māyā — land is not māyā; the desire standing before the mind is māyā, O Guhēśvara.
speaker: Allama Prabhu
notes: Skeleton from memory; locator is the incipit (or a descriptive key when the incipit is not recalled) because vacana numbering differs between editions — fix against the Samagra Vacana Sāhitya in Phase D.
